verdict.rationale: Mastra documents deploying a Mastra server to any Node.js-compatible environment and running on Node.js, Bun, Deno, or Cloudflare, which suggests agents can be served over HTTP from managed platforms like Cloudflare. However, the evidence never shows a first-party managed runtime for agents (the hosted Studio is for testing and traces) or explicitly documents the agent HTTP API surface. missing for 10: first-party managed agent hosting, explicit documentation of agent API endpoints and how to call them, independent or hands-on corroboration of a deploy-and-call flow.
